summary: Examples of with_nested granting users access to multiple databases, with literal lists or a users variable.
questions: How do I grant several users access to several databases?
Can I use a variable in with_nested?

answer_card.title: with_nested examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- community.mysql.mysql_user:
    name: "{{ item[0] }}"
    priv: "{{ item[1] }}.*:ALL"
    append_privs: yes
    password: "foo"
  with_nested:
    - [ 'alice', 'bob' ]
    - [ 'clientdb', 'employeedb', 'providerdb' ]
```

You can replace a literal list with a variable, e.g. `- "{{ users }}"`.
